name_en: Celadon Prunus Vase with Inlaid Cloud and Crane Design
official_name_en: Celadon Prunus Vase with Inlaid Cloud and Crane Design
description: 운학문 상감과 팽팽한 실루엣으로 고려청자의 정수를 보여주는 매병입니다.
description_en: The iconic Goryeo celadon maebyeong, celebrated for its cloud-and-crane inlay and taut, elegant silhouette.
hook: A vase where cranes drift through jade-green air.
